metadata.title: LiDAR for Scotland Phase V DTM
metadata.abstract: The Scottish Public Sector LiDAR (Phase 5) was initially captured by Fugro for Scottish Power Energy Network (SPEN) from 2020 to 2021 to monitor their overhead power cable network under their Virtual World Asset Management programme. The Scottish Government procured this dataset with a contribution from SEPA for public use in 2021. This dataset reflects the Digital Terrain Model (DTM) produced from the point cloud data.

responsibleOrganisation.name: Scottish Government, Geographic Information Science and Analysis Team (GI-SAT), Directorate for Digital

product: Scottish Public Sector LiDAR Phase5,0.5m bare-earth DTM. Metadata describes2020–2021 capture; exact tile date not asserted.
attribution: Contains Scottish Government and SEPA information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.
heightDatum: British National Grid terrain metres; catalogue does not explicitly state vertical datum. Relative differences only; absolute datum not asserted.
rasterSampling: Exact0.5mF32 crop,mosaicked without resampling; PROJ3.7.2 inverse OSTN15 grid transform then bilinear sampling to3m native grid.

coordinateTransform.pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=deg xy_out=rad step inv proj=hgridshift grids=uk_os_OSTN15_NTv2_OSGBtoETRS.tif step proj=tmerc lat_0=49 lon_0=-2 k=0.9996012717 x_0=400000 y_0=-100000 ellps=airy

limitations: Bare-earth values under buildings are interpolated terrain,not a floor survey. Court and battery elevations are reconstructed working levels.
Host must supply comparable fine terrain. The asset never draws a duplicate hill or forces an absolute elevation.
HES Scottish Ten noncommercial raster was excluded; retained crop is only Phase5OGL3.
